title: How Claude Code works in large codebases: Best practices and where to start
translatedTitle: Claude Code 如何在大型代码库中工作：最佳实践与入手指南
subtitle: The most successful Claude Code deployments share a set of recognizable patterns across configurations, tooling, and org structure. This article is part of Claude Code at scale, a new series covering best practices for engineering organizations building with Claude Code at enterprise scale.
